title: Vent connection at base.
officialText:
Every vent stack shall connect to the base of the drainage stack. The vent stack shall connect at or
below the lowest horizontal branch. Where the vent stack connects to the building drain, the connection shall be located
downstream of the drainage stack and within a distance of 10 times the diameter of the drainage stack.
